title: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) Scans
raw_html:
National Coverage Determination (NCD) 220.6: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) Scans

Coverage Indications and Limitations

Medicare covers FDG PET scans for initial treatment strategy and subsequent treatment strategy across solid tumors, including non-small cell lung cancer, breast cancer, colorectal cancer, lymphoma, and melanoma, when medically necessary to guide patient management.

Clinical IndicationTracerCoverage Policy
Oncologic Initial Treatment StrategyFDG (F-18)Covered nationally without CED for solid tumors
Myocardial Perfusion ImagingRubidium-82 or N-13 AmmoniaCovered for suspected coronary artery disease
Alzheimer Disease Differential DiagnosisFDG (F-18)Covered for frontotemporal dementia vs Alzheimer distinction

Non-Covered Indications

Routine screening PET scans in asymptomatic Medicare beneficiaries are non-covered. Documentation must establish how PET results will alter clinical management.

title: Colorectal Cancer Screening Tests
raw_html:
National Coverage Determination (NCD) 210.3: Colorectal Cancer Screening Tests

Covered Screening Modalities

Medicare covers colorectal cancer screening for beneficiaries aged 45 to 85 years who are asymptomatic and at average risk, as well as high-risk beneficiaries without minimum age restriction.

Test ModalityHCPCS/CPTAverage-Risk Frequency
Screening ColonoscopyG0121Once every 10 years (120 months)
High-Risk Screening ColonoscopyG0105Once every 24 months
Multi-Target Stool DNA (Cologuard)81528Once every 3 years for ages 45-85
Immunoassay Fecal Occult Blood Test (iFOBT)G0328Once every 12 months

Follow-On Colonoscopy

Effective January 1, 2023, a follow-on screening colonoscopy after a positive non-invasive stool-based colorectal cancer screening test is covered as a preventive screening service with no coinsurance.

title: Home Use of Oxygen
raw_html:
National Coverage Determination (NCD) 240.2: Home Use of Oxygen

Blood Gas Coverage Criteria

Medicare covers home oxygen therapy for beneficiaries with severe lung disease or hypoxia-related symptoms who demonstrate documented hypoxemia at rest, during exercise, or during sleep.

Coverage GroupArterial PaO2 ThresholdSpO2 ThresholdAdditional Requirement
Group I (Chronic Hypoxemia)55 mmHg or below88 percent or belowNo secondary diagnosis required
Group II (Borderline Hypoxemia)56 to 59 mmHg89 percentDependent edema, cor pulmonale, or hematocrit > 56%

Documentation Requirements

A qualifying blood gas study or pulse oximetry reading must be obtained within 30 days prior to the initial date of service, and the treating practitioner must document clinical necessity in the medical record.

title: Implantable Automatic Defibrillators (ICDs)
raw_html:
National Coverage Determination (NCD) 20.4: Implantable Automatic Defibrillators

Covered Clinical Indications

Medicare covers implantable cardioverter defibrillators (ICDs) for secondary prevention following cardiac arrest due to ventricular fibrillation or sustained ventricular tachycardia, and for primary prevention in patients with severely reduced left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF).

Prevention CategoryLVEF RequirementWaiting Period / Precondition
Secondary PreventionAny LVEFDocumented prior cardiac arrest or sustained VT
Primary Prevention (Ischemic Cardiomyopathy)LVEF <= 35%At least 40 days post-MI and 90 days post-revascularization
Primary Prevention (Non-Ischemic)LVEF <= 35%NYHA Class II or III on optimal medical therapy >= 3 months

Shared Decision Making

For primary prevention ICD implantation, patients must complete a formal shared decision making encounter using an evidence-based decision tool prior to device implantation.

title: Blood Counts
raw_html:
National Coverage Determination (NCD) 190.15: Blood Counts

Indications for Coverage

Complete blood counts (CBC), hemoglobin, hematocrit, and white blood cell differentials are covered when medically necessary to evaluate anemia, hematologic malignancy, acute infection, bleeding disorders, or chemotherapy toxicity monitoring.

Test ComponentCPT CodeCovered Purpose
CBC with Automated Differential85025Evaluation of suspected infection, leukemia, or bone marrow suppression
CBC without Differential85027Monitoring known anemia, thrombocytopenia, or chronic kidney disease

Limitations

Routine blood count panels ordered solely for preventive screening without signs, symptoms, or qualifying clinical history are excluded from Medicare coverage.
